detailed_descriptions.en: Crack the Pack is an incremental game all about opening card packs. Discover cards, sell your duplicates, and invest in a powerful upgrade tree. Open your boosters ! Unlock up to 8 different types of boosters. From packs that improve with every use, to mega-packs containing dozens of cards, or even packs with a 50/50 chance of screwing you over, you’ll never run out of surprises ! Collect them all ! Every card comes in 7 increasingly rare and valuable variants , each with almost magical powers ! That’s a total of 1,001 collectible cards to discover. Grow in power ! Over 60 upgrades will let you open packs on a massive scale, sell your cards for top dollar, and unlock new features such as employees, card battles, the Fusion Lab, the Museum, and more... Can you collect all 1,001 cards ?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Crack the Pack is an incremental game all about opening card packs. Discover cards, sell your duplicates, and invest in a powerful upgrade tree.

Open your boosters !

Unlock up to 8 different types of boosters. From packs that improve with every use, to mega-packs containing dozens of cards, or even packs with a 50/50 chance of screwing you over, you’ll never run out of surprises !

Collect them all !

Every card comes in 7 increasingly rare and valuable variants, each with almost magical powers ! That’s a total of 1,001 collectible cards to discover.

Grow in power !

Over 60 upgrades will let you open packs on a massive scale, sell your cards for top dollar, and unlock new features such as employees, card battles, the Fusion Lab, the Museum, and more...

Can you collect all 1,001 cards ?
